Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Reader-test in a fresh context
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: Stage 3 “Reader Testing”: paste the draft into a fresh Claude with no prior context to catch blind spots before others read it.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Paste images in for alt-text
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: If embedded images lack alt-text, ask the user to paste each image into chat so the agent can generate descriptive alt-text.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Confirm before searching tools
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: When the user points to channels or connected tools, wait for explicit user confirmation before searching integrations.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Brainstorm & draft sections
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: Act as an active guide: brainstorm 5–20 options per section, then draft and iteratively refine the document.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: No AI/network on PHI
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: De-identification runs as a standalone local script with no network and no AI calls — the agent never sees raw PHI.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Never read re-id mapping
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: Never read or display the re-identification mapping file; it holds the original PHI values.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Read only report + audit log
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: Only the scan report (no raw values), the hash-only SHA-256 audit log, and the de-identified output may be read.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Quote items, never invent
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: Report/checklist items are quoted from the guideline and never invented; missing items are not marked present.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Fail fast if checklist absent
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: If the required reporting checklist is missing, fail fast rather than generating a guessed one.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Block unverified findings
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: Output / self-check rails block the agent from emitting unverified or unsupported findings (fact-check & hallucination rails).

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Constrain topics & actions
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: Input and dialog rails restrict what the agent will discuss or act on.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Validate output vs spec
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: Validate every output against the RAIL spec before it reaches the user; on failure reask, fix, filter, or refrain.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Enforce report structure
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: Structured-schema validation rejects any output that doesn't match the required report structure.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Art 14 · human oversight
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: High-risk systems must allow effective human oversight — a person can review and override the output.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Art 10 · data governance
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: Input data must be governed — relevant, representative, and for health data lawfully de-identified.

Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.label: Art 12 · traceability
Radiologist|AI-assisted report drafting.text: Automatic logging must make the system's operation traceable across its lifecycle.

Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.label: Reader-test in a fresh AI
Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.text: Explain that this approach helps ensure the doc works well when others read it (including when they paste it into Claude). Ask if they want to try this workflow or prefer to work freeform.

Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.label: Edit in place, never reprint
Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.text: Use str_replace to make edits (never reprint the whole doc)

Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.label: Only in an approved PHI environment
Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.text: Only inside an environment your organization has approved for PHI, with the right vendor agreements, access controls, retention settings, and de-identification practices. The prompts themselves do not solve that governance problem.

Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.label: Prompts ≠ HIPAA-compliant
Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.text: The prompts do not make an AI tool HIPAA-compliant and do not create a safe PHI-processing environment. Use approved privacy, security, de-identification, and vendor-review workflows.

Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.label: Input rail can reject input
Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.text: Input rails: applied to the input from the user; an input rail can reject the input, stopping any additional processing, or alter the input (e.g., to mask potentially sensitive data, to rephrase).

Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.label: Output rail can reject output
Physician (Primary Care)|Adopting ambien.text: Output rails: applied to the output generated by the LLM; an output rail can reject the output, preventing it from being returned to the user, or alter it (e.g., removing sensitive data).

Medical Resident|AI-assisted literature.label: Never fabricate numbers
Medical Resident|AI-assisted literature.text: and claims must be verified against your data; the toolkit never fabricates numbers

Medical Resident|AI-assisted literature.label: Evidence-traceable reports
Medical Resident|AI-assisted literature.text: Report Generation: Produce evidence-traceable research reports with Scientific Writing and document tools; Clinical Reports outputs remain visibly marked drafts built only from verified synthetic, de-identified, or aggregate source facts

Medical Resident|AI-assisted literature.label: Low-stakes critical evaluation
Medical Resident|AI-assisted literature.text: Critical analysis: Scientific Critical Thinking and qualitative, low-stakes Scholar Evaluation of works—never ranking people or supporting consequential decisions

Medical Resident|AI-assisted literature.label: Index sources before generation
Medical Resident|AI-assisted literature.text: Why wait for sources? Sources must be indexed before chat or generation. Takes ~30 seconds to several minutes per source (see the processing-times table below).

Medical Resident|AI-assisted literature.label: Authenticate before any command
Medical Resident|AI-assisted literature.text: Before using any command, you MUST authenticate:

Academic Researcher|Writing a competitiv.text: Anti-sycophancy discipline: scores ≥ 7 require specific dialogue-turn citations; Zone 3 triggers re-audit; no motivational framing.

Academic Researcher|Writing a competitiv.label: Wait for explicit user confirmation

Academic Researcher|Writing a competitiv.text: Wait for user confirmation before searching

Academic Researcher|Writing a competitiv.label: Match the intended voice
Academic Researcher|Writing a competitiv.text: Match the voice - Fit the intended tone (formal, casual, technical). Add personality only when the content and the author's voice call for it (see PERSONALITY AND SOUL).

Academic Researcher|Writing a competitiv.label: Never invent a source
Academic Researcher|Writing a competitiv.text: (If a real source exists, name it. Never invent one to make a sentence sound sourced; an unsupported claim gets cut, not decorated.)

Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.label: Agent once, Session per run
Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.text: Mandatory flow: Agent (once) → Session (every run). model/system/tools live on the agent, never the session. See shared/managed-agents-overview.md for the full reading guide, beta headers, and pitfalls.

Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.label: Build MCP servers
Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.text: Create MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. The quality of an MCP server is measured by how well it enables LLMs to accomplish real-world tasks.

Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.label: Force cite-only prompts
Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.text: Prone to hallucinated citations — always add "Cite only sources you are certain of. If uncertain, say [uncertain]."

Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.label: Ground: don't extrapolate
Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.text: For grounded tasks add "Base your response only on the provided context. Do not extrapolate."

Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.label: Scope prompts to file paths
Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.text: Always scope to specific files and directories — never give a global instruction without a path anchor

Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.label: Wait for networkidle
Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.text: ✅ Do wait for page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') before inspection

Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.label: Always close the browser
Software Engineer|Developing an AI codin.text: Always close the browser when done

Data Scientist|Building an LLM-powered a.label: Zero formula errors
Data Scientist|Building an LLM-powered a.text: Zero formula errors. Never ship while recalc.py reports errors_found. If you think an error predates you, prove it: load the *original* with data_only=True and look at that cell. An error you introduced looks exactly like one you inherited.

Data Scientist|Building an LLM-powered a.text: Confidence tags — every inferred relationship is marked EXTRACTED, INFERRED, or AMBIGUOUS. You always know what was found vs guessed.
